SELECT c.comment_id AS comment_id, c.user_id AS user_id, u.nickname AS nickname, u.img_url AS avatar_url, c.comment_text AS comment_text, c.like_count AS like_count, c.dislike_count AS dislike_count, c.gmt_create AS gmt_create FROM comments c LEFT JOIN users u ON c.user_id = u.user_id WHERE c.video_id = #{videoId} AND c.enable = 1
ORDER BY c.gmt_create DESC, c.comment_id DESC ORDER BY c.like_count DESC, c.gmt_create DESC
